subtopics.label: Cellular Senescence and Molecular Aging Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of aging including cellular senescence, epigenetic clocks, DNA methylation, NAD+ metabolism, telomere biology, and senolytic interventions. Covers pathways such as mTOR, SIRT1/SIRT6, STAT signaling, and age-related genomic instability.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease and Neurodegenerative Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on Alzheimer's disease biomarkers (amyloid-beta, tau, neuroinflammation), neuroimaging, disease mechanisms including microglial activation and neurovascular dysfunction, and therapeutic targets. Includes studies on disease progression, cognitive decline, and preclinical detection.

subtopics.label: Brain Imaging, Cerebrovascular Disease, and Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies using neuroimaging (MRI, PET, QSM) to assess cerebrovascular pathology, white matter hyperintensities, brain iron deposition, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, glymphatic function, and their associations with cognitive impairment and dementia. Includes corneal nerve imaging as a surrogate biomarker.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Mental Health, and Psychotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on depression in older adults including neurobiological correlates, psychotherapy interventions (PATH, Engage & Connect, PROTECT), cognitive-behavioral approaches, and treatment of late-life depression with executive dysfunction. Covers suicidal ideation, anhedonia, and mental health service delivery in geriatric populations.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Abuse, and Adult Protective Services
subtopics.description: Research on identification, assessment, prevention, and response to elder mistreatment including physical abuse, financial exploitation, and neglect. Covers emergency department-based response teams, screening tools, legal adjudication, caregiver risk factors, and psychosocial interventions for abuse victims.

subtopics.label: Frailty, Geriatric Syndromes, and Functional Decline
subtopics.description: Studies on frailty assessment and its clinical consequences including falls, dysphagia, polypharmacy, delirium, and functional decline in older adults. Covers frailty as a predictor of surgical outcomes, heart failure prognosis, and geriatric vulnerabilities across disease contexts.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home Quality, Staffing, and Long-Term Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on nursing home and long-term care quality, staffing levels, ownership structures (private equity, REITs), clinician roles (SNFists), palliative care delivery, and resident outcomes. Includes studies on COVID-19 impacts on nursing homes and workforce challenges in long-term care settings.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving, Family Caregiver Support, and Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on family caregivers of persons with dementia and older adults, including caregiver burden, self-efficacy, psychosocial interventions, pain and health of caregivers, and integration of caregiver needs into primary care. Covers dementia care coordination gaps and hospice care for dementia patients.

subtopics.label: Technology, Cognitive Training, and Digital Health for Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on technology-based interventions for cognitive training, functional skills, and social engagement in older adults, including adherence to digital programs, wearable devices, virtual reality, and mobile health applications. Covers the digital divide, older adults' technology adoption, and assistive technologies for aging in place.

subtopics.label: Aging with HIV: Geriatric Syndromes, Inflammation, and Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on aging-related complications in people living with HIV including frailty, cognitive impairment, inflammation, epigenetic aging, and comorbidities. Covers biomarkers of aging (cell-free mitochondrial DNA, epigenetic clocks), geriatric assessment, and interventions such as metformin in older HIV-positive adults.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health, Disparities, and Care Fragmentation
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social determinants of health, neighborhood conditions, race, and care fragmentation affect health outcomes in older adults including hospitalization, stroke, heart failure, and mortality. Covers racial disparities in care quality, Medicare spending variation, and preventable adverse events.

subtopics.label: Aging, Pulmonary Disease, and Age-Related Immune Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Research on age-related changes in lung biology and immunity including interstitial lung abnormalities, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, impaired antiviral responses in aged lungs, and senescence-related lung pathology. Covers aging effects on pneumococcal and influenza immunity and COVID-19 lung senescence.

subtopics.label: Cancer Biology, Aging, and Oncology in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the intersection of aging and cancer including age-related molecular changes promoting tumor progression (methylmalonic acid, clonal hematopoiesis), geriatric assessment in oncology, cancer survivorship, and treatment outcomes in older cancer patients. Covers pan-cancer aging signatures and senescence in cancer.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure, Cardiovascular Disease, and Geriatric Cardiology
subtopics.description: Research on heart failure and cardiovascular disease in older adults including polypharmacy, deprescribing, geriatric vulnerabilities, home health care transitions, social determinants of outcomes, and cognitive decline after heart failure. Covers geriatric cardiology practice and management of HFpEF and HFrEF in elderly populations.

subtopics.label: Stroke, Cerebrovascular Events, and Neurological Outcomes in Aging
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke in older adults including risk factors, post-stroke cognitive and functional outcomes, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, subdural hemorrhage, and long-term stroke sequelae. Covers disparities in stroke care and post-stroke depression.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Risk Factors, and Age-Related Vulnerability
subtopics.description: Research examining how age, comorbidities, and demographic factors influence COVID-19 severity, hospitalization, mortality, and post-discharge outcomes, including immune response and vaccination effects in older adults.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Complications and Cognitive Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Studies investigating cognitive deficits, neurological sequelae, and functional recovery in COVID-19 patients, including rehabilitation outcomes and the impact of SARS-CoV-2 on brain function and dopaminergic neurons.

subtopics.label: Pain Management, Chronic Pain, and Musculoskeletal Conditions in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on pain assessment, treatment approaches, and the psychological and functional impact of chronic pain and musculoskeletal conditions in older adults, including beliefs, interventions, and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Social Isolation, Loneliness, and Well-Being in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies examining the health consequences of social isolation and loneliness in older adults, including associations with mortality, dementia, depression, and the role of social support and physical activity.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Trauma, and Acute Care
subtopics.description: Research on emergency department care, trauma outcomes, and acute care delivery for older adults, including geriatric emergency fellowships, fall-related injuries, burn injuries, and inclusion of older adults in clinical research.

subtopics.label: Liver Fibrosis, Hepatic Metabolism, and Cognitive Outcomes in Aging
subtopics.description: Studies linking liver fibrosis, hepatic steatosis, and metabolic dysfunction to cognitive impairment, dementia risk, and brain structural changes in aging populations.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Integrity and Neurovascular Dysfunction in Aging and Disease
subtopics.description: Research investigating blood-brain barrier permeability, neurovascular unit dysfunction, and cerebral microvascular changes in aging, Alzheimer's disease, and related neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Procedures, Surgical Outcomes, and Age-Related Risk
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes of cardiovascular interventions including valve replacement, coronary revascularization, aortic repair, and catheter ablation in older and high-risk patients, with attention to age- and sex-related differences.

subtopics.label: Spinal and Orthopedic Surgery Outcomes in Elderly Patients
subtopics.description: Research on surgical outcomes, complications, and functional recovery following spinal, orthopedic, and musculoskeletal procedures in elderly patients, including cervical fusion, fracture repair, and lumbar degeneration.

subtopics.label: Diabetes, Metabolic Dysfunction, and Aging
subtopics.description: Studies on the epidemiology, complications, and metabolic mechanisms of type 2 diabetes in aging populations, including associations with morbidity, mortality, and age-related metabolic changes.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Home Care, and Remote Care Delivery for Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the use of telehealth, telemedicine, and remote monitoring technologies to deliver care to older adults in home and long-term care settings, including feasibility, outcomes, and barriers.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Medicare Patients, Healthcare Utilization, and Preventable Spending
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing high-cost Medicare beneficiaries, patterns of healthcare utilization, potentially preventable spending, and care coordination gaps among older adults with complex chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Clocks, Biological Age, and Aging Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research using epigenetic clocks, DNA methylation, and transcriptional aging frameworks to measure biological age, identify age-modulating compounds, and examine social and environmental influences on epigenetic aging.

subtopics.label: Hypothalamic Neuroendocrine Regulation, Sex Hormones, and Aging
subtopics.description: Studies on sex hormone receptor distribution, estrogen receptor signaling, and hypothalamic neuronal changes associated with aging, menopause, and hypertension in animal models.

subtopics.label: Hospice, Palliative Care, and End-of-Life Decision-Making in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on hospice utilization, palliative care needs, end-of-life preferences, and outcomes among older adults with serious illness including dementia, liver disease, and cancer.

review_notes: Deviation from plan acceptance criteria accepted: 30 subtopics vs 8-15 target, 84.1% coverage vs 85% target. D-01 extension pass behavior is correct and authorized. Flagged for D-21 gate in Plan 05.
